This captivating scent is reminiscent of lazy summer days, filled with laughter and the simple joys of life, transporting you to a place of unbridled happiness and carefree delight.

Ekora Bazaar's Bubble Gum Fragrance Oil is meticulously crafted to elevate luxury artisan candles, fine perfumes, and bespoke personal care products to new heights of olfactory excellence. With its premium quality and exceptional strength, this fragrance oil ensures a potent scent throw that will leave a lasting impression, making it an ideal choice for those who demand the very best. Whether you're seeking to create a unique ambiance or simply wish to indulge your senses, this extraordinary fragrance oil is the epitome of luxury and refinement.

fragranceNotes.top: A vibrant introduction of juicy fruit notes and sweet citrus
fragranceNotes.heart: A refined core featuring floral hints and creamy vanilla
fragranceNotes.base: A warm foundation of smooth musk and rich amber

name: New Aqua Fresh Fragrance Oil (candle)

As the first light of dawn breaks, the New Aqua Fresh Fragrance Oil envelops you in an invigorating aura, reminiscent of a refreshing morning stroll along a serene lake shore, where the gentle lapping of waves against the shore creates a soothing melody that awakens the senses and revitalizes the spirit.

This exquisite fragrance oil is meticulously crafted to elevate luxury artisan candles, fine perfumes, and bespoke personal care products, boasting an exceptional scent throw that fills any space with its crisp, clean aroma, a true testament to the premium quality and sophistication that Ekora Bazaar embodies.
